'''Barst Roite''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Major/Legends|major]] for the [[Thyferran Home Defense Corps]]. Roite handled the day-to-day operations of the Defense Corps, despite [[Aerin Dlarit]], a high ranking member of the [[Xucphra Corporation]], being assigned as the [[General/Legends|general]] of the Corps.<ref name="bacta" />
